products.name: Vay tien mat (cash loan)

amountMaxVnd.note: Cash page: up to 101 million VND. CONTRADICTION: FAQ Q18 says up to 130 million for consumer and cash products.

termMinMonths.note: FAQ Q19: 9 to 60 months depending on the installment product; not cash-specific. Cash page shows no term values.

minPercent.note: No standard minimum rate published; framework lists 0 as a floor for promotions only.

maxPercent.note: Framework ceiling, not a quoted product rate: direct cash disbursement ceiling 4.99%/month, 59.90%/year reducing (flat ceiling 2.94%/month, 35.33%/year). Rate framework page: interest is on reducing balance ('du no giam dan'), formula sum(balance x days x annual rate)/365. It also lists flat-basis ceilings. These are caps, so the actual customer rate is unknown. Page lists 0 as the lowest rate for every product (promotions).

percentOfPrincipal.note: 6% of remaining unpaid principal from the date HD SAISON accepts the request. T&C (applied from 06/01/2025) section 9.3 says the fee is the HIGHER of this and the total interest of all remaining instalments, but never below the minimum. FAQ: partial prepayment has no fee; full prepayment does.

fixedVnd.note: Minimum floor for cash and vehicle loans (T&C section 10), not a fixed fee.

researchNotes: LICENSE CHECK: id hd-saison is present in data/licensed-institutions.json (finance company, license 67/GP-NHNN dated 2/8/2017, from the SBV finance-company list). The licensed list did not exist when research started; checked afterwards. Rates: the only official rate page is a ceiling table (khung lai suat) with no effective date (footer 2020); no actual customer rates, no worked examples, and no standalone loan fee schedule (biểu phí) found, only a card fee schedule PDF (not read). Loan T&C PDF (applied from 06/01/2025) used for early repayment fee (6% or remaining interest if higher; min 1.5M VND cash/vehicle, 240k VND goods), late interest (150% of monthly effective rate), 4% schedule-change fee; its text extraction had broken diacritics but numbers were clear. Contradictions: cash max 101M (cash page) vs 130M (FAQ); age 18-70 (procedure page, FAQ) vs 19-60 on an older page seen in search snippets; framework page says reducing balance yet lists both flat and reducing ceilings. Insurance An Tam Tai Chinh is optional per FAQ though listed in every product document set; contract form allows financing the premium; premiums not found. hdsaison.com.vn without www has a certificate error; www works. 0% promotions advertised without conditions. Secondary-source promo rates (e.g. from 1.99%/month loyalty cash loan 2023-24, 1.5%/month union) were not recorded.
